test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Identify the part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error.** A. The final decision was made B. between the two countries C. after long negotiation D. and several meetings.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. after long negotiation .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"after long negotiation"** contains a grammatical error. The correct form should be **"after long negotiations."**
 
• The word **"negotiation"** is a singular noun, but in this context, it should be in plural form because it refers to multiple discussions or instances of negotiating.
 
• The correct sentence should be: **"The final decision was made between the two countries after long negotiations and several meetings."**

Correct sentence: *The final decision was made between the two countries after long **negotiations** and several meetings*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When discussing a series of discussions or formal talks, the plural form **"negotiations"** is commonly used.
 
• In English grammar, it is important to match the noun form (singular/plural) with the intended meaning or context.
